verses.text: Dear friends, don’t believe every spirit. Test the spirits to see whether they’re from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
Here’s how you recognize God’s Spirit: every spirit that acknowledges Jesus Christ came in the flesh is from God,
and every spirit that doesn’t acknowledge Jesus isn’t from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you’ve heard is coming and is already in the world.
Dear children, you belong to God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.
They belong to the world, so they speak from the world’s viewpoint, and the world listens to them.
We belong to God, and whoever knows God listens to us; whoever doesn’t belong to God doesn’t listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
Dear friends, let’s love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
Whoever doesn’t love doesn’t know God, because God is love.
This is how God showed his love among us: he sent his one and only Son into the world so we could live through him.
This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
Dear friends, since God loved us like this, we should love one another too.
No one has ever seen God. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love is made complete in us.
This is how we know that we remain in him and he in us: he has given us his Spirit.
We’ve seen and testify that the Father sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.
If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in them, and they remain in God.
We’ve come to know and trust the love God has for us. God is love, and whoever remains in love remains in God, and God remains in them.
This is how love is made complete among us, so that we’ll have confidence on judgment day: in this world we are like Jesus.
There’s no fear in love. Complete love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. Whoever fears hasn’t been made complete in love.
We love because he loved us first.
Whoever claims to love God but hates a brother or sister is a liar. Anyone who doesn’t love their brother or sister, whom they’ve seen, can’t love God, whom they haven’t seen.
He has given us this command: whoever loves God must also love their brother and sister.
